name: Can I sue for emotional distress caused by childbirth malpractice?

mainEntity.name: Can I sue for emotional distress caused by childbirth malpractice?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, in many childbirth malpractice cases, victims and sometimes their immediate family members can pursue compensation for emotional distress. This includes the psychological impact of trauma, grief, anxiety, and depression resulting from a negligent birth injury to the mother or child. These non-economic damages are a significant component of many malpractice claims. Proving emotional distress often involves documentation from therapists, psychologists, or other mental health professionals, along with personal testimony about the impact on your life.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, you can sue for emotional distress, such as trauma, grief, and anxiety, resulting from childbirth malpractice. This is a form of non-economic damage.
